how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-zul-gurub-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8181:details:0: My delvings into the Mosh'aru Tablets bear grim news, ⟦1⟧. Hakkar's true ⟦E1⟧, the god himself, can be born again through the very egg into which you captured him. Yeh'kinya told you it was to contain his evil, but it is to recreate it! The troll has led you astray!
rows.quest:8181:details:1: Go to Yeh'kinya and demand the egg from him. Pray that it is not too late to stop Hakkar's return!
rows.quest:8181:completion:0: So, you have been speaking with that old dwarf Ironboot and uncovered the lost Mosh'aru Tablets, have you? That meddling prospector...
rows.quest:8181:completion:1: No matter. It is too late to save this world. Hakkar has been reborn, and even now grows in power... deep in the ancient troll kingdom of Zul'Gurub! He has come! And he will rule in blood and terror!
rows.quest:8181:completion:2: Thank you, ⟦2⟧. Your help has sped the return of the Soulflayer!

rows.quest:8059:details:0: Warlocks tread dangerous ground in dealing with demons, but our demoniacs take this one step further. Through an ancient and arcane ritual, they allow a ⟦E20⟧ to enter their being. rows.quest:8059:details:1: For you to learn of the power of the demoniac, I must have Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub. Go there and retrieve that which we seek.
rows.quest:8059:progress:0: Have you returned with the Paragons of Power?  By defeating the diabolic minions of the Hakkar, you will not only prove yourself to us, but also your willingness to learn the ways of the demoniac.
rows.quest:8059:completion:0: Well done... no doubt they were made to pay in excruciating ways before they gave up the Paragons of Power. Take this - the demoniac's wraps. Made from powerful mojo used in summoning the demoniac's prey, it is a powerful tool in your acquisition of power.
rows.quest:8060:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing ⟦E21⟧. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than ⟦E13⟧ with the Zandalar Tribe.

rows.quest:8060:details:0: Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists. They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's ⟦E3⟧!
rows.quest:8060:details:2: It is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our ⟦E3⟧ to their knees from their own madness!
rows.quest:8060:details:3: For you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power. For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.
rows.quest:8060:progress:0: ⟦45⟧ - you've returned already?  Were you able to get the Paragons of Power I need?
rows.quest:8060:completion:0: Impressive... could you feel the mojo flowing through them? The Paragons of Power were used as currency of sorts back when the Gurubashi Empire ruled these lands. Now we Zandalar will use the latent mojo inside of them to fight the second rise of the ⟦E19⟧ God Hakkar!
rows.quest:8060:completion:1: You've done well today - consider yourself to have a friend in the Zandalar. For that, here are the illusionist's wraps I promised!

rows.quest:8061:details:0: We Zandalar invest power in those who speak with the authority of divinity. Our priests are more than just healers - they are our confessors. Evil comes both from outside threats - such as Hakkar - and from within the tribe. Our confessors act as the judges amongst us, preserving us from the same evil that devoured the Gurubashi from inside itself.
rows.quest:8061:details:1: Go to Zul'Gurub and bring back the Paragons of Power from the Gurubashi. Learn what it means to be the confessor, and preserve us from evil.
rows.quest:8061:progress:0: ⟦E22⟧ from Zul'Gurub, are you?  Have you succeeded in retrieving the Paragons of Power from the minions of Hakkar?
rows.quest:8061:completion:0: Outstanding, ⟦46⟧! This was no small feat bringing these to me. No doubt you've acted as our tribe's confessor today in preserving ourselves against the ⟦E23⟧ of Hakkar. These wraps are befitting a friend of the tribe such as you!

rows.quest:8062:details:0: In the dark times after the fall of the Gurubashi Empire, Zandalar predators used their prowess to provide sustenance for the tribe. Hunters claim to be much like our tribe's predators - to seek the hunt is to embody the essence of the predator, yes. Your hunt in Zul'Gurub, however, will show us how you truly rate amongst our finest predators.
rows.quest:8062:details:1: Bring to me a sampling of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub. Do so, and you'll take first steps in becoming the penultimate predator.
rows.quest:8062:progress:0: Hunt those in Zul'Gurub that would possess the Paragons of Power, ⟦47⟧.  They are your prey; they possess that which we both must have.
rows.quest:8062:completion:0: Yes... I need no vision to sense the presence of the Paragons of Power. Your success in Zul'Gurub has impressed many among the tribe. We not only consider you to be a friend of the Zandalar, but also consider you worthy enough to possess the predator's bracers - powerful items, and a symbol of what it means to be a predator. Well done, ⟦48⟧.

rows.quest:8063:progress:0: Seek the madness from within Zul'Gurub and overshadow it with your own, ⟦49⟧!  To do so means success, and success means reward!  Let not the ⟦E19⟧ God reign supreme again!
rows.quest:8063:completion:0: Well done, ⟦50⟧... your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub have earned you the right to call the Zandalar tribe as a friend. I will see to the disposition of the Paragons; for your effort please accept this reward!
rows.quest:8064:obj:0: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a ⟦E24⟧. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E14⟧. You must also be ⟦E25⟧ with Zandalar.
rows.quest:8064:details:0: We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around. Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so. To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them. That is the real power of nature.

rows.quest:8066:completion:1: You are to be commended - and rewarded - for your success. You are ⟦E30⟧ amongst the tribe, and you are worthy to wear the predator's belt.

rows.quest:8067:details:0: We Zandalar prize what we wear as a symbol of accomplishment. You don't need to be able to see what one wears to be able to sense what emanates from it - power transcends sight. The garments of the Zandalar predator are like this, and most cherished by them is the mantle they wear. It helps to obfuscate them from view... and to make their presence known when they wish it.
rows.quest:8067:details:1: The Paragons of Power await your retrieval in Zul'Gurub. Bring me what I seek, and the predator's mantle shall be yours.
rows.quest:8067:progress:0: Have your strikes into Zul'Gurub yielded success, ⟦56⟧?  Only when you've brought me what I seek - and proven yourself fully to the tribe - will you earn a mantle second to none amongst the Zandalar.
rows.quest:8067:completion:0: Success... you are to be ⟦E15⟧ amongst the tribe, ⟦57⟧. rows.quest:8068:details:0: Magic is a raw, primal force to be shaped by those strong enough to do it. Mojo is our extension of this power; one such potent manipulation of it is in the ⟦E1⟧ of illusion. How can one truly hope to win against a foe that is not even really there? We Zandalar know the power of this, and as such illusionists hold a ⟦E30⟧ place within the tribe.
rows.quest:8068:details:1: Take the needed Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub - for this, honor from the tribe and a powerful mantle used by our best illusionists will be yours!
rows.quest:8068:progress:0: How was your foray into Zul'Gurub?  Did you drive your ⟦E3⟧ mad through the power of illusion?  Illusion or not, their deaths - and the Paragons of Power taken from them - will help thwart the rise of Hakkar.

rows.quest:8069:details:0: The tribe acknowledges station and power through what we wear. Our vestments are made from the finest of materials, and interwoven with the mojo we use to make us powerful. Illusionists are no exception; their robes are said to embody the essence of illusion in their look. Legend states that their ancient robes never looked the same twice.
rows.quest:8069:details:1: I will give you an illusionist's robe, ⟦59⟧... but earn your place of ⟦E34⟧ among the tribe first! Bring me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub!
rows.quest:8069:progress:0: Have you returned with the Paragons of Power we need?  I know it will not be easy... but I have long predicted an outsider would come to aid us in our fight against Hakkar.  Let it be you, I say!
rows.quest:8069:completion:0: At last, someone worthy to wear the illusionist's robe! Your success in Zul'Gurub has assured your reverences amongst the tribe for ages to come. Wear it with pride, ⟦60⟧!
rows.quest:8070:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a ⟦E24⟧. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than ⟦E25⟧ with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8070:obj:1: Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:8070:details:0: Shortly after the fall of the Gurubashi, we Zandalar almost succumbed to a final defeat from evil within our own tribe. It was then that the confessors amongst us arose, preserving the tribe by banishing out those who would destroy their own kind. They not only keep us in tune with the spirits, but they also preserve the flesh.
